muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿عم﴾: «عن» is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the elided alif, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by ﴿عن﴾; the alif of interrogative «ما» was elided because the preposition entered upon it; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتساءلون﴾.
﴿يتساءلون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿عم يتساءلون﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿عن النبأ﴾: «عن» is a preposition, and «النبأ» is a noun in the genitive by ﴿عن﴾, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "they ask one another" (يتساءلون).
﴿العظيم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿النبأ﴾, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a genitive (majrūr), a second naʿt (adjective) of ﴿النبأ﴾.
﴿هم﴾: a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فيه﴾: «في» is a preposition, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on kasra, in the position of a genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مختلفون﴾.
﴿مختلفون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾, nominative by the wāw, because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause ﴿هم فيه مختلفون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿سيعلمون﴾: the sīn is a particle of futurity, and «يعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the object of «سيعلمون» is omitted, i.e. "they will come to know what befalls them"; the clause ﴿سيعلمون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿كلا﴾: a particle of deterrence and rebuke.
﴿سيعلمون﴾: the sīn is a particle of futurity, and «يعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the object of «سيعلمون» is omitted, i.e. "they will come to know what befalls them"; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī), and «لم» is a particle of negation, conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning], and jussive.
﴿نجعل﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn, the lām being given a kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "naḥnu" (We).
﴿الأرض﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿نجعل﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿مهادا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نجعل﴾, accusative by the fatḥa; «الجعل» (making) here has the meaning of "causing to become"; or «الجعل» has the meaning of creating, and ﴿مهادا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿والجبال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «الجبال» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned in the previous ayah.
﴿أوتادا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of the omitted verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa. The clause is conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وخلقناكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «خلق» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the mīm is a sign of the plural.
﴿أزواجا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of ﴿خلقناكم﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وجعلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «جعل» is a past verb indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿نومكم﴾: «نوم» is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعل﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿سباتا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿جعل﴾, accusative by the fatḥa; «الجعل» (making) here has the meaning of "causing to become"; or «الجعل» has the meaning of creating, and ﴿سباتا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وجعلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «جعل» is a past verb indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿الليل﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعل﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿لباسا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿جعل﴾, accusative by the fatḥa. «الجعل» (making) here has the meaning of "causing to become", or the meaning of creating, ﴿لباسا﴾ [then] being a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وجعلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «جعل» is a past verb indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿النهار﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعل﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa.
﴿معاشا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿جعل﴾, accusative by the fatḥa. «الجعل» (making) here has the meaning of "causing to become", or the meaning of creating, ﴿معاشا﴾ [then] being a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿وبنينا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «بنى» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿فوقكم﴾: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بنينا﴾; the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿سبعا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿شدادا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سبعا﴾, accusative by the fatḥa; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وجعلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «جعل» is a past verb indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿سراجا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿جعلنا﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿وهاجا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿سراجا﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; «الجعل» (making) here has the meaning of creating only; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وأنزلنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «أنزل» is a past verb indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿من المعصرات﴾: «من» is a preposition, and «المعصرات» is a noun in the genitive by the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾.
﴿ماء﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿ثجاجا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ثجاجا﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; it is evidently a naʿt of ﴿ماء﴾], accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause ﴿نجعل﴾.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿لنخرج﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and «نخرج» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by «أن» implied after the lām, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن نخرج﴾ is in the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾.
﴿به﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of a genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نخرج﴾.
﴿حبا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿ونباتا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿نباتا﴾ is a noun conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative by the fatḥa; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وجنات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «جنات» is a noun conjoined to ﴿حبا﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural.
﴿ألفافا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿جنات﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿يوم﴾: the noun of «إن», accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; it is muḍāf.
﴿الفصل﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿كان﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (it).
﴿ميقاتا﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause ﴿إن يوم الفصل...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿يوم﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿يوم الفصل﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿ينفخ﴾: an imperfect verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named).
﴿في﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) preposition.
﴿الصور﴾: a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the preposition and its genitive noun are in the position of a nominative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فتأتون﴾: the fāʾ is an indeclinable conjunction, and «تأتون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تأتون﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ينفخ﴾.
﴿أفواجا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «تأتون», accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿وفتحت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «فتحت» is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿السماء﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿فكانت﴾: the fāʾ is an indeclinable conjunction, and «كانت» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, the tāʾ being for the feminine; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya" (it), referring back to «السماء».
﴿أبوابا﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿فتحت﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ينفخ﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وسيرت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «سيرت» is a past verb, passive (built for that whose agent is not named); the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿الجبال﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿فكانت﴾: the fāʾ is an indeclinable conjunction, and «كانت» is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, the tāʾ being for the feminine; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya" (it), referring back to «السماء» [Translator's note: so in the source, apparently carried over from the previous ayah; here the pronoun refers back to «الجبال»].
﴿سرابا﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿سيرت﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ينفخ﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿جهنم﴾: the noun of «إن», accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿كانت﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, the tāʾ being for the feminine; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hiya" (it).
﴿مرصادا﴾: the khabar of kāna, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and the clause ﴿إن جهنم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿للطاغين﴾: the lām is an indeclinable (mabnī) preposition, and «الطاغين» is a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مرصادا﴾.
﴿مآبا﴾: the second khabar of kāna, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿لابثين﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الطاغين», accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa [Translator's note: so in the source; as a sound masculine plural, «لابثين» is accusative by the yāʾ].
﴿فيها﴾: «في» is a preposition, and ﴿ها﴾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of a genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لابثين﴾.
﴿أحقابا﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), attached to ﴿لابثين﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يذوقون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿فيها﴾: «في» is a preposition, and ﴿ها﴾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يذوقون﴾.
﴿بردا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is a particle for reinforcing the negation.
﴿شرابا﴾: a noun conjoined to ﴿بردا﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿لا يذوقون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿لابثين﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿إلا﴾: a particle, and restriction [Translator's note: so in the source («أداة وحصر»); presumably "a particle of exception and restriction" was intended].
﴿حميما﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿شرابا﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿وغساقا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «غساقا» is a noun conjoined to ﴿حميما﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿جزاء﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they are recompensed with a recompense", accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿وفاقا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿جزاء﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿إنهم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position; the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a nominative, the noun of «إن» [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun of «إن» is in the position of an accusative], and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿كانوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "hum" (they) [Translator's note: so in the source; the noun of «كانوا» is the overt attached wāw of the plural].
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يرجون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿حسابا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿لا يرجون﴾ is in the position of an accusative, the khabar of kāna; the clause ﴿كانوا لا يرجون﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; and the [whole] clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وكذبوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كذب» is a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿بآياتنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبوا﴾.
﴿كذابا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in some dialects; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the one before it.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وكل﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. «كل» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, accusative (manṣūb) by preoccupation (ʿalā al-ishtighāl), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿شيء﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿أحصيناه﴾: a past verb indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿كتابا﴾: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿وكل شيء أحصيناه﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿فذوقوا﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of resumption indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, and «ذوقوا» is an imperative verb indeclinable on the elision of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿فلن﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «لن» is a particle of negation, accusative and futurity, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿نزيدكم﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "naḥnu" (We); the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿عذابا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿لن نزيكم﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, for «لن نزيدكم»] is conjoined to ﴿فذوقوا﴾, and the clause ﴿فذوقوا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position.
﴿للمتقين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾.
﴿مفازا﴾: the postponed noun of «إن», accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿حدائق﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿مفازا﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿وأعنابا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أعنابا» is conjoined to ﴿حدائق﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وكواعب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كواعب» is conjoined to ﴿حدائق﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿أترابا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كواعب﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وكأسا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كأسا» is conjoined to ﴿حدائق﴾, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿دهاقا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿كأسا﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يسمعون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يسمعون﴾.
﴿لغوا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿كذابا﴾: conjoined to ﴿لغوا﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿لا يسمعون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿جزاء﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "they are recompensed with a recompense", accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿من﴾: a preposition indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.
﴿ربك﴾: a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿جزاء﴾.
﴿عطاء﴾: a badal (substitute) from ﴿جزاء﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿حسابا﴾: a naʿt of ﴿عطاء﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿رب﴾: a badal (substitute), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿السماوات﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿والأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الأرض» is conjoined to «السماوات», genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a genitive, conjoined to «السماوات».
﴿بينهما﴾: «بين» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾; the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The pronoun is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿الرحمن﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رب﴾, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra.
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يملكون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent).
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يملكون﴾.
﴿خطابا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿لا يملكون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الرحمن﴾.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لا يملكون﴾.
﴿يقوم﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿الروح﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «يقوم», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿والملائكة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «الملائكة» is conjoined to «الروح», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿صفا﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يتكلمون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw of the plural is a pronoun indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يتكلمون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, a badal (substitute) from the fāʿil of ﴿يتكلمون﴾.
﴿أذن﴾: a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أذن﴾.
﴿الرحمن﴾: the fāʿil of «أذن», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause ﴿أذِنَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «قال» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he).
﴿صوابا﴾: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿قال﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أذن﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿ذلك﴾: «ذا» is a demonstrative indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance, and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿اليوم﴾: a badal (substitute), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿الحق﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), indeclinable on fatḥa, and «من» is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ.
﴿شاء﴾: a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "huwa" (he); the clause ﴿شاء﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾.
﴿اتخذ﴾: a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of a jussive, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿إلى﴾: a preposition indeclinable on fatḥa [Translator's note: so in the source; «إلى» ends in an alif and is indeclinable on sukūn].
﴿ربه﴾: a noun in the genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra; the hāʾ is a pronoun indeclinable on kasra, in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿مآبا﴾.
﴿مآبا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿ذلك اليوم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position; and ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the noun of ﴿إن﴾.
﴿أنذرناكم﴾: «أنذر» is a past verb indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is a pronoun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of a nominative, fāʿil (agent); the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿أنذرناكم﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿عذابا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿قريبا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عذابا﴾, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa.
﴿يوم﴾: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عذابا﴾.
﴿ينظر﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿المرء﴾: the fāʿil of «ينظر», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause ﴿ينظر المرء﴾ is in the position of a genitive, the adverb being put in construct with it.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قدمت﴾: «قدم» is a past verb indeclinable on fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿يداه﴾: «يدا» is the fāʿil of «قدم», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the alif; the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿قدمت يداه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويقول﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿يقول﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma.
﴿الكافر﴾: the fāʿil of «يقول», nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma; the clause ﴿يقول الكافر﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ينظر المرء﴾.
﴿يا﴾: a particle for drawing attention (tanbīh).
﴿ليتني﴾: «ليت» is an abrogating, accusative-governing particle indeclinable on fatḥa; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative, the noun of ﴿ليت﴾; the clause ﴿يا ليتني﴾ is in the position of an accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿كنت﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb indeclinable on sukūn, and the tāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a nominative, the noun of kāna.
﴿ترابا﴾: the khabar of «كنت», accusative, the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; the clause ﴿كنت﴾ is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of ﴿ليت﴾.
